Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, behind live reels and controls
Primary request: an original full-height PEARL FORTUNE casino slot machine, unmistakably a real premium physical cabinet, soft celebratory wealth rather than royal severity
Scene/backdrop: one front-facing freestanding cabinet in a softly blurred champagne casino lounge; rounded pearl-shell crown, warm bulb marquee, ivory enamel body, champagne-gold trim, burgundy lacquer control deck, pearl ropes, blank gold coins, rubies, emeralds and diamonds integrated into side columns

Style/medium: high-end photorealistic 3D commercial slot cabinet render, physically plausible molded enamel, metal, bulbs and glass, friendly rounded art-deco silhouette
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, exact front orthographic view, cabinet fills 96 percent height and 94 percent width, all critical regions centered and unobstructed, reel aperture wide enough for five columns
Lighting/mood: warm marquee bulbs, soft cream daylight, controlled diamond sparkle, festive, inviting, highly attractive, not solemn
Color palette: pearl ivory, pale champagne gold, soft rose gold, deep warm burgundy, small emerald and ruby accents
